pages.text: Dislocators are teleporters, and all of them work across dimensions.$(li)$(item)Dislocator$(): one fixed destination, limited uses.$(li)$(item)Advanced Dislocator$(): a list of destinations, fuelled by ender pearls.$(li)$(item)Bound Dislocators$(): go to a matching dislocator or to a player.
For pedestals and portals see $(l:equipment/portals)Pedestals and Portals$(/l). For pulling in dropped items see $(l:equipment/item_dislocator)Item Dislocator$(/l).

pages.title: Dislocator
pages.text: $(l)Shift-right-click$() to save the spot you stand on, the way you face and the dimension. This cannot be changed later. Right-click to teleport there.$(br2)Each jump costs one heart, and you need more than one heart left. It has 32 uses and can be repaired with Draconium ingots on an anvil. Left-click a mob to send it there instead; sending players needs the advanced version.

pages.title: Advanced Dislocator
pages.text: $(l)Shift-right-click$() opens its screen: up to 256 named destinations. Add where you stand, double-click a name to rename it, drag to reorder, and lock entries so they are not changed by accident.

Each teleport burns one ender pearl of fuel and no health; add pearls with the fuel buttons. Right-click teleports to the selected destination. In blink mode right-click instead jumps up to 32 blocks where you look, four blinks per pearl.

pages.title: More tricks
pages.text: Controls has unbound keys to move the selection, teleport, blink or open the screen without right-clicking.$(br2)Left-click a mob to send it to the selected destination. A player can be sent too, but only while they sneak, which counts as their consent.

pages.title: Bound Dislocators
pages.text: Right-click an $(item)Un-Bound Dislocator (Point-to-Point)$() to split it into a linked pair. Either one takes you to wherever the other is: on a pedestal, in a receptacle, dropped on the ground or carried by a player.$(br2)Right-click an $(item)Un-Bound Dislocator (Player)$() to bind it to yourself. Whoever holds it can use it to reach you while you are online. Bound dislocators use no fuel and never wear out.
